title: 查找集群内的关键连接
summary: 无向连通网络中，返回删除后会使网络不再连通的所有边。
insight: DFS 时间戳 discovery 标识节点首次访问顺序，low 标识子树通过树边或返祖边能到达的最早时间；若孩子 low 严格大于父节点 discovery，该边没有替代回路，是桥。
pitfalls: 无向边回到直接父节点不算返祖边
已访问邻居用 discovery 更新 low

solutions.title: Tarjan 低链接桥
solutions.idea: 一次深搜计算每条 DFS 树边是否存在回到祖先的路径。
steps: 建无向邻接表，discovery 初始为零，time 从一递增
dfs(node,parent)：设置 discovery=low=time++；遍历邻居，跳过 parent
未访问邻居递归后 low[node]=min(low[node],low[next])；若 low[next]>discovery[node] 记录 [node,next]；已访问则用 discovery[next] 更新

code.java: class Solution { private List<List<Integer>> graph,answer;private int[] discovery,low;private int time=1;public List<List<Integer>> criticalConnections(int n,List<List<Integer>> connections){graph=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph.add(new ArrayList<>());for(List<Integer> edge:connections){int a=edge.get(0),b=edge.get(1);graph.get(a).add(b);graph.get(b).add(a);}answer=new ArrayList<>();discovery=new int[n];low=new int[n];dfs(0,-1);return answer;}private void dfs(int node,int parent){discovery[node]=low[node]=time++;for(int next:graph.get(node)){if(next==parent)continue;if(discovery[next]==0){dfs(next,node);low[node]=Math.min(low[node],low[next]);if(low[next]>discovery[node])answer.add(Arrays.asList(node,next));}else low[node]=Math.min(low[node],discovery[next]);}} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var graph:List<MutableList<Int>>;private val answer=mutableListOf<List<Int>>();private lateinit var discovery:IntArray;private lateinit var low:IntArray;private var time=1;fun criticalConnections(n:Int,connections:List<List<Int>>):List<List<Int>>{graph=List(n){mutableListOf()};for(edge in connections){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0])};answer.clear();discovery=IntArray(n);low=IntArray(n);time=1;dfs(0,-1);return answer};private fun dfs(node:Int,parent:Int){discovery[node]=time;low[node]=time++;for(next in graph[node]){if(next==parent)continue;if(discovery[next]==0){dfs(next,node);low[node]=minOf(low[node],low[next]);if(low[next]>discovery[node])answer.add(listOf(node,next))}else low[node]=minOf(low[node],discovery[next])}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<vector<int>> graph,answer;vector<int> discovery,low;int timer=1;void dfs(int node,int parent){discovery[node]=low[node]=timer++;for(int next:graph[node]){if(next==parent)continue;if(!discovery[next]){dfs(next,node);low[node]=min(low[node],low[next]);if(low[next]>discovery[node])answer.push_back({node,next});}else low[node]=min(low[node],discovery[next]);}}public:vector<vector<int>> criticalConnections(int n,vector<vector<int>>& connections){graph.assign(n,{});for(auto& edge:connections){graph[edge[0]].push_back(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].push_back(edge[0]);}discovery.assign(n,0);low.assign(n,0);answer.clear();timer=1;dfs(0,-1);return answer;} };
